page.layout: One printed page. One text column, with a narrow margin at the right holding one note beside the second paragraph. Page number at the top right, running head at the top centre. The facing page's edge at the far left is not transcribed.

main_text.l: inquam, vel senatorem, vel Militem, vel
Sed quid interim in Oriente factum?
ibi furor Licinii in Ecclesias insultare
nominiæ causa ad opus publicum dam-
nasse; alios insuper ad textrinam, alia-
que opera gynnecæa ascripsisse, id quod
ra, ignem, ensem, botrum, culeum, ro-
tam, flagellum proposita[?] et ex eorum

page.notes: The facing page's edge (left of the scan) is not transcribed. "propositaj" is uncertain: the final glyph may be a semicolon. "graffariqué" is an unusual form; the accent is as printed. "perfecutionis", "myfterijs" and "gynnecæa" are kept as printed. The paragraph ends mid-word at "con-"; the next page continues it.
